newsitem.title: USA: DTN buys out stake in Reuters venture.
newsitem.headline: DTN buys out stake in Reuters venture.

text.p: DTN Market Communications Group LLC said on Monday it acquired for $3.6 million Market Communications Group LLC (MCG), a joint venture between Reuters America Inc and Farmland Industries Inc.
MCG provides satellite based news and pricing information on commodities, energy and financial markets.

DTN, a subsidiary of Data Transmission Network Corp, said it paid $3.6 million in cash for 2,400 subscribers and assets of MCG. As a result of this acquisition, DTN said it will have over 9,000 real-time commodity subscribers.
In a related agreement, DTN said it acquired rights to distribute Reuters real-time news and information to the commodities, energy and metals markets.
Data Transmission Network provides information and communications services to agricultural, automotive, energy, farm implement, financial and weather-related industries.
Reuters America is the primary operating subsidiary of Reuters Holdings Plc. Reuters provides news, real-time financial data, transaction systems, and access to historical data bases.
